The '''ZXK-100346 system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The sixth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the system was [[ZXK-100346.6a]], and was the hiding place of a deadly [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] artifact, the [[Soulsaber]]. It was concealed there by ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and a map showing the location of the system was installed inside the [[Temples of Vormijj]] on [[Pamorjal]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] discovered the location of the system from the Temples and traveled there, in search of the Soulsaber.
